concept_options.title: The $26 loophole
concept_options.hook: Twenty-six dollars a video. That's the gig rate.
concept_options.visual_approach: Mute-first 9:16 news slam: red/amber/ink kinetic type, stacked-bill hook, view cards, camera-lens detector, X'd channel grid, phone stack. Captions are the voice. No restaging of the political attack videos.
concept_options.target_audience: Shorts viewers who have seen talking-head 'news' clips and do not know the $26 rate or the spam-not-lies takedown
key_points: A Backstage/Virelox-linked listing paid about $26 per video for real hosts
Riddance tracked 45 million-plus YouTube views and millions more on TikTok
Real faces beat synthetic-media detectors built to catch fake ones
YouTube terminated 20 channels for spam, not a public falsehood finding
Source-channel takedowns do not clear recirculated TikTok clips
concept_options.core_message: The detector loophole was a person, not a fake face.
concept_options.cta: Read Semafor Sep 2–3 and TNW Sep 4 before sharing the next talking-head clip.
concept_options.why_this_works: It is this week's news ABOUT YouTube and TikTok virality — $26, 45M, 20 channels, TikTok leftover — without amplifying the underlying political attack titles.

concept_options.title: Jisoo CLICK same-day MV
concept_options.hook: Jisoo dropped CLICK. 1.7 million views in four hours.
concept_options.visual_approach: Fandom kinetic type and MV stills. Chart climb, not a platform-policy story.
key_points: Jisoo CLICK hit about 1.7 million views in four hours on Sep 4, 2026
HRS Skibidi topped Korea YouTube trending music the same day
concept_options.core_message: A drop can own a Thursday without being news about the platforms.
concept_options.why_this_works: It is actually going viral today — but it is a fandom drop, not news about YouTube/TikTok mechanics.

concept_options.title: Spam, not lies
concept_options.hook: YouTube killed twenty channels. For spam. Not for being false.
concept_options.visual_approach: Slower civic cut: YouTube quote card, policy vs truth distinction, leftover TikTok beat.
key_points: YouTube's cited violation was spam and deceptive practices
That is not a public finding that each political claim was false
TikTok recirculation survived the YouTube takedown
concept_options.core_message: Enforcement for spam is not the same as a truth ruling.
concept_options.cta: Read the YouTube statement in Semafor Sep 3.
concept_options.why_this_works: Sharper civic frame, but a 60s cut misses the 30s viral brief.

selected_concept.rationale: Cloud production request is implicit approval. c1 is the only concept that is both in the news this week and about YouTube/TikTok virality. c2 is a same-day entertainment chart. c3 is the civic 60s cut.
modifications: Keep the spam-not-lies line as a 6-second beat, not the whole short
Do not restage or quote the political attack video titles

stages.approach: Lock a live Sep 4 2026 YouTube/TikTok news story from Semafor + TNW. Reject same-day entertainment chart-climbers as the A-story.
Present remotion, hyperframes, and ffmpeg. Lock ffmpeg because the JS runtimes are missing. Captions-as-voice. $0.
Mute-first 30s slam: $26 / 45M / detector / 20 channels / still on TikTok. Every claim sourced.
Five text-card stills with Ken Burns. Safe type in the 900x1400 zone. Caption rail at y=1480.
